inheritanceRule: Repository-local constitutions and agent rules may specialize or strengthen this contract, but may not weaken human agency, truthfulness, evidence, privacy, safety, reversibility, founder authority, provenance, or non-deletion.

statusDefinitions.enforced: The repository has a local entrypoint and constitution, and its primary AGENTS.md explicitly loads the entrypoint.
statusDefinitions.partial: The repository has a local entrypoint and constitution, but its primary AGENTS.md does not yet explicitly load the entrypoint.
statusDefinitions.missing: The repository is missing the local entrypoint, the local constitution, or both. Local repository rules remain authoritative until a focused inheritance PR is reviewed.

challengeStackStatusDefinitions.on-main: The ordered founder challenge stack has been re-observed in the repository's current main carrier. This proves source-controlled instruction state only.
challengeStackStatusDefinitions.pending-main: The ordered founder challenge stack exists on a bounded candidate or pull request but has not yet been re-observed on current main. It must not be reported as landed.

challengeStackTruthBoundary: Challenge-stack coverage records source-controlled instruction state only. on-main does not prove an agent loaded the carrier, followed the sequence, executed a provider action, passed CI, deployed, changed runtime state, or achieved a human outcome. pending-main must never be reported as landed. External coverage is continuity evidence only and never promotes an external repository into FCR authority.
truthBoundary: This registry records repository instruction inheritance only. It does not prove runtime behavior, deployment, provider execution, user outcomes, compliance, or that an external agent actually loaded the files.
